parsedConfig.title: Delivery & Returns
parsedConfig.summary: Delivery coverage, tracking, payment-based stock reservation, returns, and support after checkout.

blocks.title: Delivery coverage
blocks.body: We deliver across Pakistan through courier partners. Timelines vary by city, courier capacity, and address accuracy.
bullets: Major cities usually move faster than remote areas
Correct phone number and address help avoid delays
Tracking is shared when available after confirmation

blocks.title: Shipping charges
blocks.body: Shipping charges depend on checkout settings, payment method, promotions, and order value at the time of purchase.
bullets: Prepaid orders may qualify for free delivery or discounts
COD fee is calculated at checkout
Final total is shown before order submission

blocks.title: Returns
blocks.body: If there is an issue after delivery, contact support with your order number and product photos if relevant.
bullets: Keep original packaging where possible
Return eligibility depends on verification and policy window
Refund or replacement timelines depend on case approval

blocks.title: Support
blocks.body: For the fastest help, message support with your order number, phone number, and a clear description of the issue.

blocks.title: Stock Reservation
blocks.body: Prepaid orders are reserved when payment is verified. COD stock is reserved after WhatsApp or phone verification. Orders are fulfilled in confirmation order while stock remains available.

blocksUr.title: ڈیلیوری کوریج
blocksUr.body: ہم پاکستان بھر میں کوریئر پارٹنرز کے ذریعے ڈیلیوری کرتے ہیں۔ وقت شہر اور پتے کے مطابق بدل سکتا ہے۔

blocksUr.title: شپنگ چارجز
blocksUr.body: شپنگ فیس چیک آؤٹ سیٹنگز، ادائیگی کے طریقے، آفرز اور آرڈر ویلیو کے مطابق لگتی ہے۔

blocksUr.title: واپسی
blocksUr.body: ڈیلیوری کے بعد مسئلہ ہو تو آرڈر نمبر اور تصاویر کے ساتھ سپورٹ سے رابطہ کریں۔

blocksUr.title: سپورٹ
blocksUr.body: تیز مدد کے لیے آرڈر نمبر، فون نمبر اور مسئلے کی واضح تفصیل بھیجیں۔

blocksUr.title: اسٹاک ریزرویشن
blocksUr.body: پری پیڈ آرڈر ادائیگی کی تصدیق پر محفوظ ہوتے ہیں۔ COD اسٹاک واٹس ایپ یا فون تصدیق کے بعد محفوظ ہوتا ہے۔ دستیاب اسٹاک میں آرڈر تصدیق کی ترتیب سے پورے کیے جاتے ہیں۔

parsedConfig.title: Privacy Policy
parsedConfig.summary: How we collect, protect, and use customer information when you browse, place an order, or contact support.

blocks.title: Information we collect
blocks.body: We collect the details needed to process and deliver your order, support your routine, and keep the website working securely.
bullets: Name, phone number, email, city, and delivery address
Order history, payment method, order status, and support messages
Device, browser, analytics, referral, and conversion data

blocks.title: How we use it
blocks.body: Your information is used for fulfilment, support, fraud prevention, and improving the shopping experience.
bullets: Confirm and deliver orders
Send order updates by WhatsApp, SMS, email, or phone
Improve product pages, checkout, and customer support

blocks.title: Sharing and protection
blocks.body: We do not sell personal information. We only share what is necessary with delivery partners, payment providers, analytics tools, or legal authorities when required.
bullets: Courier partners receive delivery details
Payment providers receive payment verification data
Access is limited to authorised operations and support use

blocks.title: Your choices
blocks.body: You can ask us to correct your details, remove unnecessary data where legally possible, or stop marketing communication.
bullets: Contact support through the website, WhatsApp, or email
You can disable browser cookies, but some features may work less smoothly

parsedData.questionEn: What is the Renewal Peel?
parsedData.questionUr: رینیول پیل کیا ہے؟
parsedData.answerEn: Some users notice a light, visible shedding of old skin in the first week or two. This is not a side effect. It's how Retinol works. It helps the outermost layer make way for fresher, smoother skin. If it feels excessive, drop to twice a week and apply a light moisturiser underneath. It's temporary.
